tests.name: Package Structure
tests.run: test -f autonav_beginner/src/lidar_publisher.cpp && test -f autonav_beginner/src/obstacle_detector.cpp && test -f autonav_beginner/src/drive_decider.cpp && test -f autonav_beginner/CMakeLists.txt && test -f autonav_beginner/package.xml

tests.name: Obstacle Detector — Content Validation
tests.run: FILE=autonav_beginner/src/obstacle_detector.cpp && grep -qE '"obstacle_detector"' $FILE && grep -qE '/lidar/ranges' $FILE && grep -qE '/obstacle/status' $FILE && grep -q 'CLEAR' $FILE && grep -q 'WARNING' $FILE && grep -q 'DANGER' $FILE && grep -qE '(0\.5|1\.5)' $FILE

tests.name: Drive Decider — Content Validation
tests.run: FILE=autonav_beginner/src/drive_decider.cpp && grep -qE '"drive_decider"' $FILE && grep -qE '/obstacle/status' $FILE && grep -qE '/robot/action' $FILE && grep -q 'MOVE FORWARD' $FILE && grep -q 'SLOW DOWN' $FILE && grep -q 'STOP' $FILE

tests.name: CMakeLists.txt — Executables & Dependencies
tests.run: FILE=autonav_beginner/CMakeLists.txt && grep -q 'lidar_publisher' $FILE && grep -q 'obstacle_detector' $FILE && grep -q 'drive_decider' $FILE && grep -q 'rclcpp' $FILE && grep -q 'std_msgs' $FILE
